title: StudioBrain Platform File
description: Per-surface / per-build declaration of engine/framework choice and default model/weight rows (SBAI-7974). THIS is where platform divergence lives — never in divergent code paths. Catalog providers stay as templates/Providers/*.provider.yaml (never a single providers.yaml). Shipped defaults live in templates/Platforms/*.platform.yaml. A project or build overlay may drop a singular platform.yaml next to the app.

id.description: Stable slug. Shipped defaults use the surface name (web, desktop, ios, android).

surface.description: The product surface this file describes. Distinct from model-manager engines.schema.json `$defs.platform` (OS/arch/gpu build artefacts for engine binaries).

os.description: Optional OS filter when one surface file is too coarse (e.g. desktop-windows).

engine.description: Surface-wide preferred/required engine. Per-capability defaults may override. Shorthand string = taxonomy category with requirement=preferred.

limits.description: Surface-wide caps. Settings overlay these at runtime.

defaults.description: Default provider + optional weight/model row per capability on this surface. References catalog ids; does not duplicate catalog bodies. Executor selects among admissible rows; this array names the preferred starting point, not a fallback chain (fallback ordering stays in settings).

capability.description: Matches provider `provides` tags and in-app weight-row `capability`.

engine.description: Per-capability engine override. Shorthand string = taxonomy category with requirement=preferred.

weight.description: Optional catalog weight-row id (e.g. on-device/gemma-4-e2b-it-q4f16-webgpu). For wire:in-app providers.

model.description: Optional live-list model id for network providers (not a weight row).
